excluded_metrics.l1tex_global_store_lookup_hit: Candidate bypasses L1 stores and supplies no equivalent hit count.
excluded_metrics.lts_tex_write_lookup_miss: Model write residency misses do not have validated NCU lookup semantics.

limits: Continuous modeled warmup and measurement replay; scope selection does not recreate physical range synchronization.
CTA round-robin order is modeled, not a measured physical arrival order.
Initialization, nonkernel DMA, timing, MSHR concurrency and cross-kernel L1 retention are not modeled.
Dirty writebacks are charged to the service/eviction kernel, including warmup-origin dirty lines; no terminal drain.
Hardware ranges are independent protocols: do not combine whole, Decode and steps into one accuracy denominator.
